cases.input: 帮我找20个 geek风、戴眼镜、欧美白人，粉丝数在1万到10万之间的 ins 平台 KOC
clarification:
可以。已明确的范围是：**Instagram、20位 KOC、粉丝1万–10万、戴眼镜**。开始前需要集中确认三点，避免把“geek风”和“欧美白人”筛偏：

1. **“geek风”指什么？**  
   是外观／穿搭上的书卷气、极客感，还是要求本人分享科技、编程、游戏等内容？若是内容方向，请说明哪些算。

2. **“欧美白人”的范围怎么定？**  
   创作者所在地是限定**美国、加拿大及哪些欧洲国家**，还是所在地不限？白人身份只能依据本人明确自述核验，不能从肤色、长相或姓名推断；没有自述证据的会标为待核实。

3. **戴眼镜的要求是什么？**  
   近期内容中经常佩戴普通眼镜即可，还是需要大多数出镜都戴？太阳镜是否排除？

另外建议设置**逐人分析预算100位，目标入选20位**；这是分析人数上限，不是付费金额，也不保证一定凑齐。你是否接受？

KOC 会另设必选条件：**个人消费者型创作者，以本人体验和分享为主，排除品牌、公司或店铺官方账号**。视觉风格和戴眼镜需要观察实际内容，不能仅凭头像判断。确认上述口径后再开始；此前研究和 Campaign 保持不变。
cases.reply: geek风我说的是偏书呆子、极客的穿搭，眼镜要本人戴，个人KOC身份也单独检查；白人只按本人公开自述，没证据就待核实。所在地看美国、加拿大、英国、德国、法国。先只拿 Instagram 的 tylerlcrawford 和 valstechtalkk 这两个账号做这一轮，两个都分析并打好内容方向、风格、眼镜和公开身份的标签。这轮只用已有文字资料，不打开网页，不需要人工介入，外观资料不够也别猜。入选目标仍保留20人，分析预算20，但候选限定这两个，不扩搜。直接开始，这批全结束再给我结构化文档，缺多少写清楚。

{"caption":"I have the 16 Pro, 17 Pro, and 18 Pro, so I shot the same things on all three to figure out who should actually upgrade.

Each year changed a different part of the camera. The 17 Pro was about zoom and selfies, with a zoom lens four times sharper and a front camera that auto-rotates and reframes. The 18 Pro changed none of that. Same zoom lens, same sensor. What’s new is a main camera that physically opens and closes, pulling in about 50 percent more light at night or closing down to keep more of the scene sharp, plus manual control for the first time.

On a 16 Pro, upgrade. You get two years at once. On a 17 Pro, only if you shoot low light or want manual control. And the 16 Pro actually zooms further than both.

Save this before you buy and send it to your friend who upgrades every single year.

node.text:
My apartment runs itself, and this one is everything that happens while I am asleep.

Shades close at 9:22. Kitchen shelf lights shut off at 9:50, which is my signal that the day is over. The Pura kicks on lavender. My Eight Sleep adjusts the bed temperature all night based on my body. The humidifier holds the room at 60%. And 45 minutes after sunrise the blackout layer opens first, then the solar shades, so I wake up to the skyline instead of an alarm.

I set all of it up once and it has run every night since. That is the whole point of the hometel.

Save this for when you are ready to automate your own space and send it to whoever you share a bed with.

#smarthome #homeautomation #hometel #eightsleep #sleeproutine

This is how I keep a small apartment feeling like a hotel without actually doing the work every day. Small space, fully automated. 

Save this for when you set up your own space, and send it to whoever’s apartment never feels finished.

caption.text:
My apartment basically runs itself, and I’m not exaggerating.

These are the 4 things doing my chores for me: Easyplants that water themselves, a Roomba that cleans my floors on a schedule (and spot-cleans any mess from the app), a Pura that keeps my place smelling like a 5-star resort on a timer, and smart plugs that run all my lights so they’re on at sunset and off by 10. This is how I keep a small apartment feeling like a hotel without actually doing the work every day. Small space, fully automated. 

Save this for when you set up your own space, and send it to whoever’s apartment never feels finished.

#smartapartment #apartmentliving #smallspaceliving #smarthome

caption.text:
If you are planning a trip to New York City, here are my top three hotel picks ranked from highest to lowest price so you can find the right fit for your budget.

From a full five star luxury experience at the Equinox Hotel to the aesthetic rooftop vibes at PUBLIC to the boutique communal energy at Arlo, there is something here for every type of traveler. And if you book Arlo, use code TYLERlCRAWFORD for up to 40% off your stay.

Save this for your next NYC trip and send it to whoever you are going with.

music_asset_info.title: Cafe Mariposa

caption.text:
Two cities, two beds, one decision I still haven’t made.

Resource Furniture in LA builds a Murphy bed that lifts with a button. Sixteen thousand for the full setup. Casper and Thuma in SoHo get me to around eight for a mattress, base, and frame that actually look like they belong together.

Same room either way. One of them gives the floor back during the day. The other one costs half.

Part two is the decision.

#murphybed #smallspaceliving #apartmenttherapy #bedroomdesign #thuma

caption.text:
I never upgraded my monitor because I wasn’t spending Studio Display money, and this is what I got instead.

Built specifically for Mac. 5K Nano Gloss panel, color tuned to match your MacBook, and one Thunderbolt cable for display, data, and charging. Mac Colors, Your Way.

Save this for when you need a new monitor. Send it to someone still working off one laptop screen.

Full product links in my bio at tylerlcrawford.com/links

#ad

caption.text:
Where to stay in Manhattan, from someone who books these rooms on his own dime.

Five hotels across the two neighborhoods I actually recommend. Equinox Hotel in Hudson Yards for 5 star, where your stay includes access to the largest Equinox ever built at 60,000 square feet. The Manner in SoHo for something with real character, where the TV arrives in a suitcase if you ask. PUBLIC Hotel in SoHo if you want the most aesthetic room of the four, plus the best rooftop in the neighborhood. Arlo Midtown for the Arlo Suite terrace with three landmarks in one view. And Arlo SoHo for the rooftop and a terrace room of your own.

Swipe for the exact room types I’ve stayed in at each, how to pick between midtown and SoHo, and one booking tip most people forget until it’s too late. Code TYLERCRAWFORD gets you up to 40% off at both Arlo locations.

Save this for your trip and send it to who you’re going with.

caption.text:
Planning a holiday trip to Manhattan? Here are my top 4 hotels in the two best neighborhoods to stay in.

In midtown, the Arlo Midtown is my 4 star pick, and the Arlo Suite comes with the largest outdoor terrace I have ever had at a hotel, with views of the Empire State Building, World Trade Center, and Hudson Yards from one spot. My 5 star pick is the Equinox Hotel in Hudson Yards, where you get complimentary access to the largest Equinox ever built at 60,000 square feet. Ask for the Deluxe One Bedroom Suite.

Down in SoHo, the Arlo SoHo is the fun one with constant rooftop events, and the City Terrace room gets you private outdoor space. And The Manner is the most unique boutique hotel I have stayed at in Manhattan. The rooms do not come with a TV, but ask for one and it arrives in a suitcase.

Use code TYLERLCRAWFORD for up to 40% off at Arlo. Save this for when you are booking and send it to the friend you are going with.

caption.text:
$2,500 for one night at the Equinox Hotel NYC. Here is exactly where it went.

The Deluxe One Bedroom Suite was $2,015. On top of that, a massage at the spa, in room dining, and dry cleaning came out to $468. And the parts I keep thinking about, the turn down service and the tea, were free.

If you are staying at Equinox Hudson Yards, the spa is worth it once. But the best part of the whole night did not cost anything.

Save this for your next NYC trip and send it to whoever you are going with.

#equinoxhotel #nychotels #hudsonyards #luxuryhotel #newyorkcity

caption.text:
Here is my 3 month review of the custom dual roller shades from @3dayblinds 

Solar and room darkening in one unit. The schedule runs itself, up 45 minutes after sunrise and down at 9:22pm, but what I did not expect is how much I use the manual control. Some mornings I drop every solar shade and leave the room darkening up. Some days I want the middle window open and the left and right down. Each one moves on its own from the remote, my voice, or the app.

Probably my favorite upgrade in the apartment.

Free in-home design consultation and buy one get one 50% off through my link in bio.

Follow for more smart home reviews.

#hometel #3dayblinds #studioapartment #smarthome #ad

caption.text:
The room matters.

One Bedroom Deluxe City View Suite at the Equinox Hotel in Hudson Yards. Floor to ceiling windows over the Manhattan skyline, a separate living area, and the kind of detail you only get at a five star hotel. Guests also get full access to the flagship Equinox gym, both pools, and the classes downstairs.

Still my favorite hotel in New York City. Save this for your next NYC trip and send it to whoever you’re going with.

caption.text:
I have the 16 Pro, 17 Pro, and 18 Pro, so I shot the same things on all three to figure out who should actually upgrade.

Each year changed a different part of the camera. The 17 Pro was about zoom and selfies, with a zoom lens four times sharper and a front camera that auto-rotates and reframes. The 18 Pro changed none of that. Same zoom lens, same sensor. What’s new is a main camera that physically opens and closes, pulling in about 50 percent more light at night or closing down to keep more of the scene sharp, plus manual control for the first time.

On a 16 Pro, upgrade. You get two years at once. On a 17 Pro, only if you shoot low light or want manual control. And the 16 Pro actually zooms further than both.

Save this before you buy and send it to your friend who upgrades every single year.

#iphone18pro #iphone17pro #appleevent #cameracomparison #techreview

caption.text:
I bought the Away aluminum check-in in 2024 and just started posting about it. Almost twenty videos over two years. I emailed @away around ten times in that stretch. Nothing came of it for a long time.

A brand trip wasn’t even on my list for 2026. I didn’t think that happened to micro creators. I was wrong.

Three nights in New York, all expenses paid, and I got to meet the people who actually built the thing I’d been talking about for free.

None of this was luck. It was showing up for two years while nothing was happening.

Send this to someone who’s been showing up with nothing to show for it yet.

#TravelAway #awaypartner

caption.text:
One year ago I quit my job to do this full time. And now I’m flying to New York with @away for my first ever brand trip!!! Still processing that. 🥹

I’m taking the new Series 3 Classic, which has a few things my Topside and my aluminum don’t. CompressMore so I can actually fit more, a hidden tracker pocket so my AirTag has a home, and hideaway hooks so my duffle rides hands free through the airport.

Documenting this whole thing start to finish. Follow so you don’t miss it!

#TravelAway #awaypartner

caption.text: #courserapartner You can organize your home, your money, your calendar, but the mind is the system underneath all of it. I’m working through the Foundations of Positive Psychology Specialization on Coursera right now and the biggest takeaway so far is that optimism is a skill you can actually train. Find it on Coursera. @coursera #Upskilling #RealLifeLearning #SkillSpotlight #LearnWithoutLimits

caption.text:
One year ago I left a $118,000 software engineering job. Since January: 25+ brand partnerships, over $200,000, no agency, no manager.

Four things got me here. Post before you’re ready, then let the data refine it. Pick a cadence and hold it. Know your niche before everyone else does. And be your own brand manager, because some deals came to me, but only after I built something worth finding.

One year out, zero regrets. Save this if you’re starting, and follow for the full brand deal breakdown.

#contentcreator #branddeals #creatoreconomy #quitmyjob #6figurecreator

caption.text:
Aritzia dropped their first ever men’s sweatfleece so I ordered $900 worth to find out what’s actually different from the unisex.

The Mega fit is broader through the body with longer sleeves. The Perfect hoodie is more fitted, closer to a regular hoodie than an oversized one. The Perfect half zip is the one I keep reaching for. And the two bottoms come down to whether you want a cuffed ankle, the Jogger, or a straight leg, the Mega Straight. If you already own the unisex, size accordingly since the men’s runs broader.

Everything is linked in my bio. Save this for Christmas gift ideas and send it to your boyfriend who thought Aritzia was just for women.

#aritzia #mensfashion #sweatfleece #menswear #falloutfits

caption.text:
11 weeks until NYC turns into the most magical version of itself.

When you go, hit Bryant Park for the ice rink and the winter village, Fifth Avenue at night for the storefronts and lights, the Columbus Circle village and Hudson Yards for their light displays, and Glace for hot chocolate.

Save this for your holiday trip and send it to whoever you’re going with.

caption.text: #courserapartner I never quit my job to make this work. I taught myself editing and took Coursera certificates while I was still a full time W2 employee, evenings and weekends, and I only left when the income made leaving the obvious call. Not when I felt ready. Quitting first isn’t bravery, it’s just a worse version of the same plan. @coursera Link in bio. #Learnwithoutlimits #Upskilling #PathwaysToPossibility #CertifyYourSuccess

caption.text:
The iPhone Duo is a 5.4 inch phone closed and a 7.6 inch screen open, 50 percent bigger than the 18 Pro Max. Split view, pinned video, nano texture display, and Apple Pencil on both screens. Here’s the math nobody’s doing though. An iPhone 18 Pro Max is $1,299 and an iPad mini with the same storage is $699. That’s $1,998. The Duo is $1,999. Apple priced it one dollar above buying both, so this isn’t a price decision, it’s whether you want one device or two.

Two things I have opinions on: Touch ID instead of Face ID on a two thousand dollar phone, and the Pencil support not shipping until later this year. Would I replace my iPad? For travel, yes. For real work, no.

Preorders open October 16. Send this to whoever’s been waiting years for Apple to make a foldable and let me know if you’re getting one.

caption.text:
You can make your apartment smart for 14 dollars. Here is exactly how.

Split your lights into two piles first, lamps that plug into an outlet and lights on a wall switch, because they need different products. Lamps get a smart plug, about $28 for a 2-pack, scan the QR code and it is done. Wall switches get a SwitchBot, $26, tapes on in seconds with no wiring and nothing your landlord would care about. One thing nobody mentions though, the SwitchBot only runs basic timers on its own. If you want sunrise and sunset triggers you need their hub. Smart plugs do that out of the box.

Everything is linked in my bio. Save this for when you are ready to start and send it to whoever keeps telling you smart homes are too expensive. Some links are affiliate.

#smarthome #smartapartment #renterfriendly #apartmenttech #homeautomation

caption.text:
The 4 principles I would use if I were laying out my apartment today. Two of them come straight from feng shui.

Place your biggest pieces first, and put the bed in the commanding position, diagonal from the door with the headboard on a solid wall. Mount your TV at eye level when seated, about 42 inches floor to center. Start your rug a third of the way down the bed with 18 to 24 inches showing on the sides and foot. And keep your mirror off the wall facing your bed.

Layout Lab is officially a service now. A live session where we walk your apartment together and I map out your layout, then send you the drawn plan. Link in bio.

Save this before you move anything and send it to your friend with the TV mounted too high.

#layoutlab #apartmentlayout #fengshui #interiordesign #smallspaceliving

caption.text:
My apartment runs itself, and this one is everything that happens while I am asleep.

Shades close at 9:22. Kitchen shelf lights shut off at 9:50, which is my signal that the day is over. The Pura kicks on lavender. My Eight Sleep adjusts the bed temperature all night based on my body. The humidifier holds the room at 60%. And 45 minutes after sunrise the blackout layer opens first, then the solar shades, so I wake up to the skyline instead of an alarm.

I set all of it up once and it has run every night since. That is the whole point of the hometel.

Save this for when you are ready to automate your own space and send it to whoever you share a bed with.

#smarthome #homeautomation #hometel #eightsleep #sleeproutine

caption.text:
My apartment basically runs itself, and I’m not exaggerating.

These are the 4 things doing my chores for me: Easyplants that water themselves, a Roomba that cleans my floors on a schedule (and spot-cleans any mess from the app), a Pura that keeps my place smelling like a 5-star resort on a timer, and smart plugs that run all my lights so they’re on at sunset and off by 10. This is how I keep a small apartment feeling like a hotel without actually doing the work every day. Small space, fully automated. 

Save this for when you set up your own space, and send it to whoever’s apartment never feels finished.

#smartapartment #apartmentliving #smallspaceliving #smarthome

If you are planning a trip to New York City, here are my top three hotel picks ranked from highest to lowest price so you can find the right fit for your budget.

From a full five star luxury experience at the Equinox Hotel to the aesthetic rooftop vibes at PUBLIC to the boutique communal energy at Arlo, there is something here for every type of traveler. And if you book Arlo, use code TYLERlCRAWFORD for up to 40% off your stay.

Save this for your next NYC trip and send it to whoever you are going with.

#nychotel #newyorkcity #nyctravel #hotelreview #travelrecommendations

posts.caption:
Two cities, two beds, one decision I still haven’t made.

Resource Furniture in LA builds a Murphy bed that lifts with a button. Sixteen thousand for the full setup. Casper and Thuma in SoHo get me to around eight for a mattress, base, and frame that actually look like they belong together.

Same room either way. One of them gives the floor back during the day. The other one costs half.

Part two is the decision.

#murphybed #smallspaceliving #apartmenttherapy #bedroomdesign #thuma

posts.caption:
I never upgraded my monitor because I wasn’t spending Studio Display money, and this is what I got instead.

Built specifically for Mac. 5K Nano Gloss panel, color tuned to match your MacBook, and one Thunderbolt cable for display, data, and charging. Mac Colors, Your Way.

Save this for when you need a new monitor. Send it to someone still working off one laptop screen.

Full product links in my bio at tylerlcrawford.com/links

#ad

caption.text:
I never upgraded my monitor because I wasn’t spending Studio Display money, and this is what I got instead.

Built specifically for Mac. 5K Nano Gloss panel, color tuned to match your MacBook, and one Thunderbolt cable for display, data, and charging. Mac Colors, Your Way.

Save this for when you need a new monitor. Send it to someone still working off one laptop screen.

Full product links in my bio at tylerlcrawford.com/links

posts.caption:
Where to stay in Manhattan, from someone who books these rooms on his own dime.

Five hotels across the two neighborhoods I actually recommend. Equinox Hotel in Hudson Yards for 5 star, where your stay includes access to the largest Equinox ever built at 60,000 square feet. The Manner in SoHo for something with real character, where the TV arrives in a suitcase if you ask. PUBLIC Hotel in SoHo if you want the most aesthetic room of the four, plus the best rooftop in the neighborhood. Arlo Midtown for the Arlo Suite terrace with three landmarks in one view. And Arlo SoHo for the rooftop and a terrace room of your own.

Swipe for the exact room types I’ve stayed in at each, how to pick between midtown and SoHo, and one booking tip most people forget until it’s too late. Code TYLERCRAWFORD gets you up to 40% off at both Arlo locations.

Save this for your trip and send it to who you’re going with.

#nychotels #manhattan #nyctravel #wheretostayinnyc #holidayinnyc

caption.text:
Where to stay in Manhattan, from someone who books these rooms on his own dime.

Five hotels across the two neighborhoods I actually recommend. Equinox Hotel in Hudson Yards for 5 star, where your stay includes access to the largest Equinox ever built at 60,000 square feet. The Manner in SoHo for something with real character, where the TV arrives in a suitcase if you ask. PUBLIC Hotel in SoHo if you want the most aesthetic room of the four, plus the best rooftop in the neighborhood. Arlo Midtown for the Arlo Suite terrace with three landmarks in one view. And Arlo SoHo for the rooftop and a terrace room of your own.

Swipe for the exact room types I’ve stayed in at each, how to pick between midtown and SoHo, and one booking tip most people forget until it’s too late. Code TYLERCRAWFORD gets you up to 40% off at both Arlo locations.

Save this for your trip and send it to who you’re going with.

posts.caption:
Planning a holiday trip to Manhattan? Here are my top 4 hotels in the two best neighborhoods to stay in.

In midtown, the Arlo Midtown is my 4 star pick, and the Arlo Suite comes with the largest outdoor terrace I have ever had at a hotel, with views of the Empire State Building, World Trade Center, and Hudson Yards from one spot. My 5 star pick is the Equinox Hotel in Hudson Yards, where you get complimentary access to the largest Equinox ever built at 60,000 square feet. Ask for the Deluxe One Bedroom Suite.

Down in SoHo, the Arlo SoHo is the fun one with constant rooftop events, and the City Terrace room gets you private outdoor space. And The Manner is the most unique boutique hotel I have stayed at in Manhattan. The rooms do not come with a TV, but ask for one and it arrives in a suitcase.

Use code TYLERLCRAWFORD for up to 40% off at Arlo. Save this for when you are booking and send it to the friend you are going with.

#nychotels #manhattan #nyctravel #holidayinnyc #wheretostay

posts.caption:
$2,500 for one night at the Equinox Hotel NYC. Here is exactly where it went.

The Deluxe One Bedroom Suite was $2,015. On top of that, a massage at the spa, in room dining, and dry cleaning came out to $468. And the parts I keep thinking about, the turn down service and the tea, were free.

If you are staying at Equinox Hudson Yards, the spa is worth it once. But the best part of the whole night did not cost anything.

Save this for your next NYC trip and send it to whoever you are going with.

#equinoxhotel #nychotels #hudsonyards #luxuryhotel #newyorkcity

posts.caption:
Here is my 3 month review of the custom dual roller shades from @3dayblinds 

Solar and room darkening in one unit. The schedule runs itself, up 45 minutes after sunrise and down at 9:22pm, but what I did not expect is how much I use the manual control. Some mornings I drop every solar shade and leave the room darkening up. Some days I want the middle window open and the left and right down. Each one moves on its own from the remote, my voice, or the app.

Probably my favorite upgrade in the apartment.

Free in-home design consultation and buy one get one 50% off through my link in bio.

Follow for more smart home reviews.

posts.caption:
The room matters.

One Bedroom Deluxe City View Suite at the Equinox Hotel in Hudson Yards. Floor to ceiling windows over the Manhattan skyline, a separate living area, and the kind of detail you only get at a five star hotel. Guests also get full access to the flagship Equinox gym, both pools, and the classes downstairs.

Still my favorite hotel in New York City. Save this for your next NYC trip and send it to whoever you’re going with.

#equinoxhotel #nychotels #hudsonyards #luxuryhotel #newyorkcity

posts.caption:
I have the 16 Pro, 17 Pro, and 18 Pro, so I shot the same things on all three to figure out who should actually upgrade.

Each year changed a different part of the camera. The 17 Pro was about zoom and selfies, with a zoom lens four times sharper and a front camera that auto-rotates and reframes. The 18 Pro changed none of that. Same zoom lens, same sensor. What’s new is a main camera that physically opens and closes, pulling in about 50 percent more light at night or closing down to keep more of the scene sharp, plus manual control for the first time.

On a 16 Pro, upgrade. You get two years at once. On a 17 Pro, only if you shoot low light or want manual control. And the 16 Pro actually zooms further than both.

Save this before you buy and send it to your friend who upgrades every single year.

#iphone18pro #iphone17pro #appleevent #cameracomparison #techreview

posts.caption:
I bought the Away aluminum check-in in 2024 and just started posting about it. Almost twenty videos over two years. I emailed @away around ten times in that stretch. Nothing came of it for a long time.

A brand trip wasn’t even on my list for 2026. I didn’t think that happened to micro creators. I was wrong.

Three nights in New York, all expenses paid, and I got to meet the people who actually built the thing I’d been talking about for free.

None of this was luck. It was showing up for two years while nothing was happening.

Send this to someone who’s been showing up with nothing to show for it yet.

#TravelAway #awaypartner

posts.caption:
One year ago I quit my job to do this full time. And now I’m flying to New York with @away for my first ever brand trip!!! Still processing that. 🥹

I’m taking the new Series 3 Classic, which has a few things my Topside and my aluminum don’t. CompressMore so I can actually fit more, a hidden tracker pocket so my AirTag has a home, and hideaway hooks so my duffle rides hands free through the airport.

Documenting this whole thing start to finish. Follow so you don’t miss it!

#TravelAway #awaypartner

posts.caption: #courserapartner You can organize your home, your money, your calendar, but the mind is the system underneath all of it. I’m working through the Foundations of Positive Psychology Specialization on Coursera right now and the biggest takeaway so far is that optimism is a skill you can actually train. Find it on Coursera. @coursera #Upskilling #RealLifeLearning #SkillSpotlight #LearnWithoutLimits

posts.caption:
One year ago I left a $118,000 software engineering job. Since January: 25+ brand partnerships, over $200,000, no agency, no manager.

Four things got me here. Post before you’re ready, then let the data refine it. Pick a cadence and hold it. Know your niche before everyone else does. And be your own brand manager, because some deals came to me, but only after I built something worth finding.

One year out, zero regrets. Save this if you’re starting, and follow for the full brand deal breakdown.

#contentcreator #branddeals #creatoreconomy #quitmyjob #6figurecreator

posts.caption:
Aritzia dropped their first ever men’s sweatfleece so I ordered $900 worth to find out what’s actually different from the unisex.

The Mega fit is broader through the body with longer sleeves. The Perfect hoodie is more fitted, closer to a regular hoodie than an oversized one. The Perfect half zip is the one I keep reaching for. And the two bottoms come down to whether you want a cuffed ankle, the Jogger, or a straight leg, the Mega Straight. If you already own the unisex, size accordingly since the men’s runs broader.

Everything is linked in my bio. Save this for Christmas gift ideas and send it to your boyfriend who thought Aritzia was just for women.

#aritzia #mensfashion #sweatfleece #menswear #falloutfits

posts.caption:
11 weeks until NYC turns into the most magical version of itself.

When you go, hit Bryant Park for the ice rink and the winter village, Fifth Avenue at night for the storefronts and lights, the Columbus Circle village and Hudson Yards for their light displays, and Glace for hot chocolate.

Save this for your holiday trip and send it to whoever you’re going with.

#nyc #nycholidays #newyorkcity #nycchristmas #holidayseason

posts.caption: #courserapartner I never quit my job to make this work. I taught myself editing and took Coursera certificates while I was still a full time W2 employee, evenings and weekends, and I only left when the income made leaving the obvious call. Not when I felt ready. Quitting first isn’t bravery, it’s just a worse version of the same plan. @coursera Link in bio. #Learnwithoutlimits #Upskilling #PathwaysToPossibility #CertifyYourSuccess

posts.caption:
The iPhone Duo is a 5.4 inch phone closed and a 7.6 inch screen open, 50 percent bigger than the 18 Pro Max. Split view, pinned video, nano texture display, and Apple Pencil on both screens. Here’s the math nobody’s doing though. An iPhone 18 Pro Max is $1,299 and an iPad mini with the same storage is $699. That’s $1,998. The Duo is $1,999. Apple priced it one dollar above buying both, so this isn’t a price decision, it’s whether you want one device or two.

Two things I have opinions on: Touch ID instead of Face ID on a two thousand dollar phone, and the Pencil support not shipping until later this year. Would I replace my iPad? For travel, yes. For real work, no.

Preorders open October 16. Send this to whoever’s been waiting years for Apple to make a foldable and let me know if you’re getting one.

#iphoneduo #appleevent #foldableiphone #iphone18 #techreview

posts.caption:
You can make your apartment smart for 14 dollars. Here is exactly how.

Split your lights into two piles first, lamps that plug into an outlet and lights on a wall switch, because they need different products. Lamps get a smart plug, about $28 for a 2-pack, scan the QR code and it is done. Wall switches get a SwitchBot, $26, tapes on in seconds with no wiring and nothing your landlord would care about. One thing nobody mentions though, the SwitchBot only runs basic timers on its own. If you want sunrise and sunset triggers you need their hub. Smart plugs do that out of the box.

Everything is linked in my bio. Save this for when you are ready to start and send it to whoever keeps telling you smart homes are too expensive. Some links are affiliate.

#smarthome #smartapartment #renterfriendly #apartmenttech #homeautomation

posts.caption:
The 4 principles I would use if I were laying out my apartment today. Two of them come straight from feng shui.

Place your biggest pieces first, and put the bed in the commanding position, diagonal from the door with the headboard on a solid wall. Mount your TV at eye level when seated, about 42 inches floor to center. Start your rug a third of the way down the bed with 18 to 24 inches showing on the sides and foot. And keep your mirror off the wall facing your bed.

Layout Lab is officially a service now. A live session where we walk your apartment together and I map out your layout, then send you the drawn plan. Link in bio.

Save this before you move anything and send it to your friend with the TV mounted too high.

#layoutlab #apartmentlayout #fengshui #interiordesign #smallspaceliving
